title: Case Study: Dawnice 2.38MWh C&I Energy Storage Project in South Ostrobothnia, Finland
summary: A 2.38MWh C&I storage project in South Ostrobothnia, built from nine cabinets totalling 1125kW.
challenge: South Ostrobothnia works through freezing winters and sharp seasonal swings in demand, while electricity prices stay volatile. The client needed an outdoor system that keeps its capacity in low temperatures.
solution: Nine BS07-265 cabinets, 2.38MWh and 1125kW in total, built on 314Ah cells with cell-to-pack construction to raise energy density per cabinet.
result: The outdoor layout was chosen for space efficiency on an industrial site; the project was completed in June 2026.
